note: One Read cards. Neutral everyday topics only. When a card has a question, options[0] is the answer that matches the card; the game shuffles the options. Draft content: review before public release.

items.text: The baker opens the shop at six.
items.question: When does the baker open the shop?

items.text: A grey cat sleeps on the warm windowsill.

items.question: How many bowls does the potter shape?

items.text: The cinema shows old films on Wednesday afternoons and gives every visitor a paper ticket.

items.question: What is the roof made of?

items.question: What did the pianist adjust?

items.question: What does the seller write on top?

items.question: How often is the wind speed recorded?

items.question: What colour was the wool?

items.question: Which ridge did Ingrid set off toward?

items.text: The clockmaker's window displays eleven clocks, each set to a different time, and a note saying all of them are right somewhere.
items.question: How many clocks are in the window?

items.question: What does the mural show?

items.question: How long does the cable car take to reach the summit?

items.text: In the corner of the café, a woman writes postcards every morning and posts them all together on Friday.

items.question: What shape was the kite?

items.question: How many arches does the bridge have?

items.question: How many steps does the keeper climb?

items.text: On the first Sunday of the month the antique dealers fill the old station with clocks, chairs, mirrors, and boxes of unlabelled photographs.
items.question: Where do the antique dealers set up?

items.question: How fast does the village clock run?

items.question: What colour is the vase?

items.question: What does the man repair?
